landing.tagline: A clean place to write Markdown.
landing.editHint: This page is a live editor — click anywhere and type. Nothing is saved.

saveDialog.imagesFolderPrompt: This document has images. First, choose a folder where the images will be saved. Next, you'll choose where to save the markdown file.
saveDialog.mustSaveInFolder:
The markdown file must be saved inside the image folder "{{folder}}" (or a sub-folder of it) so image links resolve correctly.

Click OK to choose another location.

newDocModal.title: Start a new document?
newDocModal.body: This replaces the current content — anything you have not downloaded will be lost.
newDocModal.bodyCollab: The active collaboration session will be ended for all participants.

updater.availableBody: A new version (v{{version}}) is available. Download and install now?

intro.title: A Markdown-native chat input
intro.desc: The star here is the input box below — a Markdown-native field that renders live as you type. Write prompts with WYSIWYG editing: press Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a newline.

empty.example: “Show me a Markdown table and a TypeScript code block.”
empty.noKey: No API key is required. Mock streaming is enabled by default.

input.placeholder: Write with Markdown... Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline

config.title: Chat settings
config.desc: Leave empty to use mock streaming. Add your own key to stream from a real model.
config.keyNote: Your API key is saved in this browser (localStorage) and used only here. It is never sent to DOMD servers.

chat.examplePrompt: Show me a Markdown table and a TypeScript code block.

errors.auth: Invalid API key or provider error.
errors.generic: Request failed. Please check your API key or try mock mode.

playground.placeholder: Type here, or start a stream from the panel.
playground.panelDesc: Simulate AI-style Markdown streaming into a WYSIWYG document. Edit freely before and after streaming.
playground.tip: Tip: drop a Markdown file onto the editor to stream it with your current settings.
playground.boundEditorTitle: Click to change the slider's upper bound
playground.noDelay: No delay — chunks queue as fast as the browser can paint
playground.coreNote: The same 20 KB Markdown-native core powers preview, edit, and stream. This page simulates a token-by-token Markdown stream arriving from an AI model — the editor is locked while a stream is running.

crdt.headerSubtitle: Two clients · conflict-free merge · saved locally
crdt.forceSyncTitle: Merge both directions — both clients converge
crdt.resetTitle: Clear storage and start a fresh shared document
crdt.seedIntro: Edit on both sides, then merge in either direction.
crdt.seedTry: Try: type in the **same** paragraph on both clients, then merge — spans from both sides interleave without losing text.

live.headerSubtitle: Realtime op replay · remote carets · every new tab joins as one more collaborator
live.resetTitle: Clear the shared document and start fresh
live.seedIntro: Type on either side — keystrokes appear on the other side in realtime, span by span.
live.seedCarets: Watch the colored carets: that is where the other client is typing right now.
live.addPeerTitle: Open a new tab that joins this room as a new collaborator

collab.createSubtitle: Peer-to-peer over WebRTC — the document syncs directly between browsers and never touches a server.
collab.passwordPlaceholder: Optional — leave empty for link-only access
collab.passwordHint: With a password set, the link alone is not enough to join. Share the password separately.
collab.readonlyLinkHint: Read-only viewers see updates live but cannot edit, and they never appear in the collaborator list.
collab.passwordOnce: Password: {{password}} — it is not stored and cannot be shown again. Share it separately.
collab.linkOnlyHint: Anyone with this link can join (the access secret is embedded in it).
collab.passwordSetHint: Joining requires the password you set. It is not stored here.
collab.noPeers: No one else is online yet
collab.closedBanner: The host ended this session. Your local copy stays editable, but changes no longer sync.
collab.closedBannerViewer: The host ended this session. The document stays visible, but it no longer receives updates.
collab.expiredBanner: This invite link has expired. Your local copy stays editable, but changes no longer sync.
collab.expiredBannerViewer: This invite link has expired. The document stays visible, but it no longer receives updates.
collab.aloneOnline: No other participant online — edits sync when someone reconnects

join.title: Join collaborative editing
join.subtitle: You have been invited to edit a document together, live.
join.viewerSubtitle: You have been invited to view this document live. Enter the access password to continue.
join.wrongPassword: Wrong password — please check and try again.
join.invalidLink: This invite link is invalid or incomplete.
join.roomClosed: This session was ended by the host.
join.fetchingDoc: Fetching the document from a participant…
join.noPeerOnline: No participant is online right now. Keep this page open — it will sync automatically once someone comes online.
join.youAreHost: You started this session in this browser. Open the editor to manage it.
join.connectingPeer: Found a participant — establishing the peer-to-peer connection… If this takes long, a firewall may be blocking WebRTC.
